sources.official: Exophase - trophy names, descriptions and grades.
sources.psn: PSNProfiles - PSN progress targets, used only where a counter is not in the official description.
sources.advice: Our advice - mission order, location and method checked against launch-week guides (PowerPyx, PlayStationTrophies, gta.guide).

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies. The platinum is the receipt for a finished save, so it needs no route of its own: work the roadmap phases and this one lands with the last bronze, silver or gold you still owe.
trophies.where: No location: awarded automatically.
trophies.when: With your 54th trophy, on any save.
sources: Exophase - name, description and grade.
PSNProfiles - not used; the official description already gives the whole condition.
Our advice - mission order, location and method checked against launch-week guides (PowerPyx, PlayStationTrophies, gta.guide).
trophies.advice: No route of its own: every other trophy, including A Long Road for 100%, fills it. Launch guides put the set at roughly 200 hours, with no online or difficulty requirements.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Complete Gone Fishing, the opening mission. Play it as the story presents it: there is nothing optional to find, and the trophy is the milestone for finishing the job.
trophies.where: Mission: Gone Fishing. The official text names the mission only, no district.
trophies.when: At the very start of the story.
sources: Exophase - name, description and grade.
PSNProfiles - not used; a story mission needs no progress target.
Our advice - mission order, location and method checked against launch-week guides (PowerPyx, PlayStationTrophies, gta.guide).
trophies.advice: Gone Fishing is Jason's first mission after the Prologue. The trophy is not immediate: it pops the next morning at Jason's house, once the phone call to the gun store is done.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. The trophy follows the chapter, not a single job, so keep playing the story thread until the chapter closes.
trophies.where: Story chapter; no location is given beyond the chapter itself.
trophies.when: During the campaign, before Chapter 2.
sources: Exophase - name, description and grade.
PSNProfiles - not used; a chapter trophy needs no progress target.
Our advice - mission order, location and method checked against launch-week guides (PowerPyx, PlayStationTrophies, gta.guide).
trophies.advice: Chapter 1 closes with Discharge Time, the hospital escape. The trophy lands at the motel scene that opens Chapter 2, in What's in the Bag?, so do not expect it on the last cutscene.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. Follow the story thread to the end of the chapter; nothing in the official text asks for side content.
trophies.where: Story chapter; no district is named.
trophies.when: During the campaign, before Chapter 3.
sources: Exophase - name, description and grade.
PSNProfiles - not used; a chapter trophy needs no progress target.
Our advice - mission order, location and method checked against launch-week guides (PowerPyx, PlayStationTrophies, gta.guide).
trophies.advice: Chapter 2 is the shortest chapter and ends with Checking Out, the drive out of the Starlet Motel. The trophy pops the next morning in the Bayside apartment, after Welcome to Vice City.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. Complete the chapter's story thread; the trophy is a chapter gate, not a mission you can fail for good.
trophies.where: Story chapter; no district is named.
trophies.when: During the campaign, before Chapter 4.
sources: Exophase - name, description and grade.
PSNProfiles - not used; a chapter trophy needs no progress target.
Our advice - mission order, location and method checked against launch-week guides (PowerPyx, PlayStationTrophies, gta.guide).
trophies.advice: Chapter 3's last mission is The Cartel Heist at Sinfrontera National Bank. It carries its own trophy (Break the Bank), and the chapter trophy lands as the story moves to Ocean Beach.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4, the last numbered chapter. The final mission has its own gold trophy, so this one should land just before it.
trophies.where: Story chapter; no district is named.
trophies.when: Late campaign, immediately before the final mission.
sources: Exophase - name, description and grade.
PSNProfiles - not used; a chapter trophy needs no progress target.
Our advice - mission order, location and method checked against launch-week guides (PowerPyx, PlayStationTrophies, gta.guide).
trophies.advice: Chapter 4 is the longest stretch and ends with Starting From Zero. Child's Play, Headliners and VCIA Takedown inside it carry their own trophies, so clear the side work before the finale.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the story. Before you start it, clear the place-bound and partner trophies you still owe: the official text never says what stays open afterwards, so we treat the final mission as the last safe window rather than test it.
trophies.where: The closing mission. The official text names no location.
trophies.when: End of the campaign. Do your loose ends first.
sources: Exophase - name, description and grade.
PSNProfiles - not used; a story mission needs no progress target.
Our advice - mission order, location and method checked against launch-week guides (PowerPyx, PlayStationTrophies, gta.guide).
trophies.advice: The final mission is The End of the Road, the last of Chapter 5. After the credits, Continue returns you to free roam before the finale, so loose ends and 100% stay open.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. It sits on the story thread, so play it when the campaign offers it and finish the job.
trophies.where: Mission: Breakfast Run. No district is given.
trophies.when: While the story offers it.
sources: Exophase - name, description and grade.
PSNProfiles - not used; a mission needs no progress target.
Our advice - mission order, location and method checked against launch-week guides (PowerPyx, PlayStationTrophies, gta.guide).
trophies.advice: Breakfast Run is the eighth Chapter 2 mission, the first proper robbery run with both characters, across Ambrosia. The trophy pops the next morning at the motel, after the "Trust?" scene.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist. Heists reward preparation: read the setup the mission gives you before the loud part, then finish it in one run.
trophies.where: Mission: The Cartel Heist. No district is given.
trophies.when: While the story offers it.
sources: Exophase - name, description and grade.
PSNProfiles - not used; a mission needs no progress target.
Our advice - mission order, location and method checked against launch-week guides (PowerPyx, PlayStationTrophies, gta.guide).
trophies.advice: The Cartel Heist is the last of Chapter 3's 27 missions and the Sinfrontera National Bank job the whole chapter prepares for. Story-only, so it cannot be skipped.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. It is a story job: accept it when it appears and see it through.
trophies.where: Mission: Child's Play. No district is given.
trophies.when: While the story offers it.
sources: Exophase - name, description and grade.
PSNProfiles - not used; a mission needs no progress target.
Our advice - mission order, location and method checked against launch-week guides (PowerPyx, PlayStationTrophies, gta.guide).
trophies.advice: Child's Play closes the Megamundo strand in Chapter 4: Party Hard, then Adventures in Babysitting, then Child's Play. All three are story missions, so the trophy arrives on its own.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. Treat it as a set piece: keep your health and ammo topped up before you start so a failure does not send you back through it.
trophies.where: Mission: Headliners. No district is given.
trophies.when: While the story offers it.
sources: Exophase - name, description and grade.
PSNProfiles - not used; a mission needs no progress target.
Our advice - mission order, location and method checked against launch-week guides (PowerPyx, PlayStationTrophies, gta.guide).
trophies.advice: Headliners is Chapter 4's eighteenth mission and ends the Dre'Quan storyline, at the VYB club night where Real Dimez headline. Story-only, no optional steps.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown. The mission is tied to the airport, so it is a good moment to also try the VCIA free-roam trophy in the same visit.
trophies.where: Mission: VCIA Takedown. The official text names the mission, not a terminal.
trophies.when: While the story offers it.
sources: Exophase - name, description and grade.
PSNProfiles - not used; a mission needs no progress target.
Our advice - mission order, location and method checked against launch-week guides (PowerPyx, PlayStationTrophies, gta.guide).
trophies.advice: VCIA Takedown is Chapter 4's twenty-third mission and the airport heist the chapter builds to. Do not wreck the airport afterwards: you still need it for Catch Me If You Can.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory. It reads like a big operation, so carry armour and a full special weapon into it and finish it without restarting.
trophies.where: Mission: Operation Savage Glory. No district is given.
trophies.when: Late in the story, while it is offered.
sources: Exophase - name, description and grade.
PSNProfiles - not used; a mission needs no progress target.
Our advice - mission order, location and method checked against launch-week guides (PowerPyx, PlayStationTrophies, gta.guide).
trophies.advice: Operation Savage Glory is the fifth mission of Chapter 5, the last chapter, and the trophy is purely story. Save before the chapter if you still owe side-strand finales.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The official text gives the target but no checklist, so the work is everything the game counts: story, strands, collectible sets, activities, property. Use the phase counters here to see which system is still short, and leave this gold for last but one.
trophies.where: Statewide; the completion screen is the scoreboard.
trophies.when: Endgame, after the story and the optional systems.
sources: Exophase - name, description and grade.
PSNProfiles - not used; the official description already states 100%.
Our advice - mission order, location and method checked against launch-week guides (PowerPyx, PlayStationTrophies, gta.guide).
trophies.advice: The 100% checklist appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion once the story is done, and earlier work counts. Guides list roughly 70 of 80 Challenges, 300 of 397 stunts, 15 card sets, 15 meditations, 200 vehicles, 100 animals, all 8 vaults and all 39 gang operations.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts. The official text fixes the number and nothing else, so the efficient route is one stunt you can repeat cleanly rather than a hunt for 250 unique jumps. Keep the counter running; it is the only target the description names.
trophies.where: No location is given. Any stunt that the game registers counts.
trophies.when: Free roam; available whenever you have a vehicle.
sources: Exophase - name, description and grade.
PSNProfiles - not used; 250 is in the official description.
Our advice - mission order, location and method checked against launch-week guides (PowerPyx, PlayStationTrophies, gta.guide).
trophies.advice: The game counts 397 stunts and any 250 count; 100% wants 300. Stunt jumps, under-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all feed the counter in Progress, so stop at 300 rather than 397.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. The official text says there are nine types but does not list them, so treat the nine slots in this tracker as a checklist you fill in as you discover them, not as a fixed menu we invented.
trophies.where: Statewide; the official text names no activity and no venue.
trophies.when: Free roam, as you unlock activities.
sources: Exophase - name, description and grade.
PSNProfiles - not used; the official description gives the count of types (nine) as our tracker note.
Our advice - mission order, location and method checked against launch-week guides (PowerPyx, PlayStationTrophies, gta.guide).
trophies.advice: Progress > Activities lists the nine types: sports, racing, race challenges, shooting ranges, games, stunts and Top Fun drones among them. One attempt at each is enough, so sample every icon once.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Silver and bronze runs do not count, so repeat a challenge until the run is clean before moving on. The official text gives the count and the medal bar; it gives no range address.
trophies.where: The Shooting Range. The official text names the activity, not where it is.
trophies.when: Any time the range is open; do it before the 100% sweep.
sources: Exophase - name, description and grade.
PSNProfiles - not used; the official description gives the 42 and the gold bar.
Our advice - mission order, location and method checked against launch-week guides (PowerPyx, PlayStationTrophies, gta.guide).
trophies.advice: The golds total 42 across the ranges: Rodgers Ranch sits northeast of Port Gellhorn, and the Griffin ranges are on the edge of Vice City. Progress > Activities > Shooting Ranges tracks each medal, and the same 42 golds are needed for 100%.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win, not merely finish, a Top Fun drone race at every location. The official text gives 14 locations but no map, so log each first win and go back for the ones you only placed in.
trophies.where: Top Fun drone race locations. The official text gives no map.
trophies.when: Free roam, once drone racing is available.
sources: Exophase - name, description and grade.
PSNProfiles - not used; 14 is in the official description.
Our advice - mission order, location and method checked against launch-week guides (PowerPyx, PlayStationTrophies, gta.guide).
trophies.advice: Fourteen Top Fun vans each host three drone trials, and the trophy needs one win at every location, 14 in all. All 42 wins belong to the 100% sweep, so keep the activity icons on the map.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Different is the condition: one event won 20 times will not do it, so rotate through the race types and tick the counter only when a new event is won.
trophies.where: Race events across Leonida; no list is given.
trophies.when: Free roam.
sources: Exophase - name, description and grade.
PSNProfiles - not used; 20 is in the official description.
Our advice - mission order, location and method checked against launch-week guides (PowerPyx, PlayStationTrophies, gta.guide).
trophies.advice: The game has around 40 races and only 20 different wins count, so repeats are wasted. Gellhorn Raceway near Port Gellhorn is the first track; street, circuit, air and sea events all count.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. The official text names the opponent but not the water, the chapter or the challenge format, so fish when the activity is offered and take the challenge as soon as it appears.
trophies.where: Not pinned: the official text names Cal, not a fishing spot.
trophies.when: Not pinned: the official text gives no chapter or mission.
sources: Exophase - name, description and grade.
PSNProfiles - not used; no numeric target is stated or needed.
Our advice - mission order, location and method checked against launch-week guides (PowerPyx, PlayStationTrophies, gta.guide).
trophies.advice: Cal texts Jason after a Chapter 1 mission and marks his fishing challenge with a purple icon. Bring a rod and beat his score at that spot; the challenge stays available after the story.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game, meaning finish it rather than put a coin in. Pick the cabinet whose controls you like best and clear it in one sitting; the official text asks for one completion.
trophies.where: An arcade cabinet. The official text does not name the venue.
trophies.when: Free roam.
sources: Exophase - name, description and grade.
PSNProfiles - not used; one completion is the whole target.
Our advice - mission order, location and method checked against launch-week guides (PowerPyx, PlayStationTrophies, gta.guide).
trophies.advice: Four arcade games exist and finishing any one is enough. Cabinets sit in bars and arcades around Leonida, and three of the games can also be played on the in-game console at home.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand. The trophy is for the last job in the strand, so you have to see Andy's story through rather than help him once.
trophies.where: Andy's strand. The official text names no district.
trophies.when: As the strand becomes available; not marked missable.
sources: Exophase - name, description and grade.
PSNProfiles - not used; the last mission is the whole target.
Our advice - mission order, location and method checked against launch-week guides (PowerPyx, PlayStationTrophies, gta.guide).
trophies.advice: Andy's strand is Lucia-only and opens with a call around Top Billing in Chapter 3. Five jobs follow (Climbing the Cellerichain, the $5,000 fee, Peach!, Read the Label, Puff Puff Pass), and the trophy lands with Puff Puff Pass.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand. Work through his jobs in order; the trophy is at the last one, not the first.
trophies.where: Kenton's strand. No district is given.
trophies.when: As the strand becomes available; not marked missable.
sources: Exophase - name, description and grade.
PSNProfiles - not used; the last mission is the whole target.
Our advice - mission order, location and method checked against launch-week guides (PowerPyx, PlayStationTrophies, gta.guide).
trophies.advice: Kenton Rees appears at the end of Hey Arnold! and buys wreck salvage from the Keys after Island Dreams. Work his dive jobs to the last one; the strand stays open after the credits.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand. Keep going back for his jobs until the strand ends; the trophy is the strand's last job.
trophies.where: Billy's strand. No district is given.
trophies.when: As the strand becomes available; not marked missable.
sources: Exophase - name, description and grade.
PSNProfiles - not used; the last mission is the whole target.
Our advice - mission order, location and method checked against launch-week guides (PowerPyx, PlayStationTrophies, gta.guide).
trophies.advice: Billy is at the Thrillbilly Mud Club near Port Gellhorn, and his first job is Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab on dirt bikes. His five jobs end with Hometown Heroes, which finishes the strand and the trophy.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight separate stranger strands across Leonida. The official text gives the count but not the strangers or their districts, so count finished strands only, not individual jobs.
trophies.where: Statewide. The official text names no stranger and no location.
trophies.when: As strands appear; finish eight before the final mission.
sources: Exophase - name, description and grade.
PSNProfiles - not used; eight is in the official description.
Our advice - mission order, location and method checked against launch-week guides (PowerPyx, PlayStationTrophies, gta.guide).
trophies.advice: Only some strands count: the guides name Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete, while Andy, Billy, Tyrone, Moses and Yasmani have their own trophies and do not. Check the counter after each strand you finish.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand. See his jobs through to the last one; the official text names no place, so follow the strand where it goes.
trophies.where: Randy's strand. No district is given.
trophies.when: As the strand becomes available; not marked missable.
sources: Exophase - name, description and grade.
PSNProfiles - not used; the last mission is the whole target.
Our advice - mission order, location and method checked against launch-week guides (PowerPyx, PlayStationTrophies, gta.guide).
trophies.advice: Randy appears in the Chapter 3 mission Car Service, then Steal the Zorrusso for Randy opens his wishlist. Deliver all 17 cars on the list, tracked under the map's Robberies tab; a WAiNK scan flags a wanted car.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand. Complete his jobs in order and this lands on the last one.
trophies.where: Tyrone's strand. No district is given.
trophies.when: As the strand becomes available; not marked missable.
sources: Exophase - name, description and grade.
PSNProfiles - not used; the last mission is the whole target.
Our advice - mission order, location and method checked against launch-week guides (PowerPyx, PlayStationTrophies, gta.guide).
trophies.advice: Tyrone's strand runs through La Perle: Tyrone, then Here, Kitty Kitty, then the Kitty Litter lab jobs. Clear the labs and finish his last mission, Shut Down the Labs.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. The official text gives the count and no map, so sweep by district and tick each spot as you find it; a repeat visit to the same spot will not advance the count.
trophies.where: Statewide. No spot, district or map is given.
trophies.when: Free roam, at any point.
sources: Exophase - name, description and grade.
PSNProfiles - not used; 18 is in the official description.
Our advice - mission order, location and method checked against launch-week guides (PowerPyx, PlayStationTrophies, gta.guide).
trophies.advice: There are 18 meditations across 10 spots, and Jason and Lucia can each do them, so bring your partner. The Chapter 1 balcony meditation at Jason's house disappears when the chapter ends, and 100% only needs 15 of the 18.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. The official text calls the animal unique but does not name the species or the ground, so take Bret's job and finish the hunt he sets up rather than guessing at a landmark.
trophies.where: Not pinned: the official text names Bret, not a hunting ground.
trophies.when: Not pinned: no chapter or mission is given.
sources: Exophase - name, description and grade.
PSNProfiles - not used; one hunt is the whole target.
Our advice - mission order, location and method checked against launch-week guides (PowerPyx, PlayStationTrophies, gta.guide).
trophies.advice: Bret's hunting business is Jason-only and starts with Meet Bret at his cabin near Mount Kalaga. Work the Target Decks and, per PowerPyx, take the Snapmatic Buck at night northeast of Grayson with a clean head or heart shot.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete three full collectible card sets. The official text fixes the number of sets, not the cards or their spawn points; finish whole sets instead of spreading pickups thin, and use the set's own card list to see what is missing.
trophies.where: Card spawns across Leonida. The official text gives no locations.
trophies.when: Free roam; collect as you explore.
sources: Exophase - name, description and grade.
PSNProfiles - not used; three sets is the official target.
Our advice - mission order, location and method checked against launch-week guides (PowerPyx, PlayStationTrophies, gta.guide).
trophies.advice: Cards arrive in numbered sets and three complete sets earn this; 15 sets are needed for 100%. Keep the cards a set needs instead of selling them at pawn shops, and check collection progress in the pause menu.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. It is a repeatable action, so the count is the only bar; the official text gives no locations, and the counter here is the way to know how far you are.
trophies.where: Anywhere the action is offered. No map is given.
trophies.when: Free roam.
sources: Exophase - name, description and grade.
PSNProfiles - not used; 100 is in the official description.
Our advice - mission order, location and method checked against launch-week guides (PowerPyx, PlayStationTrophies, gta.guide).
trophies.advice: WAiNK is a phone app, and 100 scans of Landmarks (31), Curiosities (35), Sculptures (23) and No Flusher tags complete it. The pause map's Points of Interest list filters WAiNK Locations, so use it as the checklist.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. The in-game challenge list is the authority on what counts; the official text gives the count only, so work the list and keep the running total here.
trophies.where: Statewide; the official text names no challenge.
trophies.when: Spread across the whole run; some challenges only appear late.
sources: Exophase - name, description and grade.
PSNProfiles - not used; 50 is in the official description.
Our advice - mission order, location and method checked against launch-week guides (PowerPyx, PlayStationTrophies, gta.guide).
trophies.advice: There are 80 Challenges under Progress > Challenges and this needs 50. Many complete while you play, like mini-golf under par or a $500 mugging spree, and 70 are needed for 100%.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Reach a 4-star wanted level, then lose it with your partner and get clear. Build the heat deliberately, keep your partner with you, and if the level falls below four stars before you shake it, reset and try again: the condition is the four-star escape.
trophies.where: Anywhere with your partner; no district is named.
trophies.when: While you are working with your partner. Failure only costs the attempt.
sources: Exophase - name, description and grade.
PSNProfiles - not used; the condition is the whole target.
Our advice - mission order, location and method checked against launch-week guides (PowerPyx, PlayStationTrophies, gta.guide).
trophies.advice: Vault jobs start at four stars on their own, so do this with your partner during one. The trophy waits until you are clear of the red heat zone, not just the search area; a train tunnel north of Ambrosia is a good hiding place.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops back-to-back with your partner and keep the wanted level up between them. Plan three shops close together before you start; losing the level, or a long gap, breaks the chain and you begin again.
trophies.where: Three shops of your choosing. The official text gives no addresses.
trophies.when: While you are working with your partner. Retryable.
sources: Exophase - name, description and grade.
PSNProfiles - not used; the three-shop chain is the whole target.
Our advice - mission order, location and method checked against launch-week guides (PowerPyx, PlayStationTrophies, gta.guide).
trophies.advice: Call your partner and rob three shops in a row without letting the wanted level drop; hiding until the stars fade breaks the chain, even inside the heat zone. Give it about 30 seconds after the third shop before a fourth.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Getting behind the wheel of a model for the first time is what registers it, so vary your steals and pickups rather than driving the same car; the official text gives the count only.
trophies.where: Statewide; no vehicle list is given.
trophies.when: Free roam, across the whole run.
sources: Exophase - name, description and grade.
PSNProfiles - not used; 100 is in the official description.
Our advice - mission order, location and method checked against launch-week guides (PowerPyx, PlayStationTrophies, gta.guide).
trophies.advice: Scanning a car with WAiNK counts it as discovered, so scan traffic as you drive. 100 discoveries earn this, and 200 of the 277 base models are needed for 100%.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies inside one Combat Focus. Save the ability for a crowded fight, activate it with five targets in view, and chain the kills without letting the window close; a failed attempt costs nothing but the cooldown.
trophies.where: Any fight with enough enemies. No location is named.
trophies.when: Any time Combat Focus is available.
sources: Exophase - name, description and grade.
PSNProfiles - not used; five in one window is the whole target.
Our advice - mission order, location and method checked against launch-week guides (PowerPyx, PlayStationTrophies, gta.guide).
trophies.advice: Max the Focus bar first: level 4 plus all 42 shooting range golds with the same character. Then start Combat Focus with L3 and R3 among gang enemies at an Illegal Operation and use an assault rifle; adrenaline tops the meter up.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA: leave the airport in a way its schedule did not plan for. The official text names the airport but not the method or the vehicle, so treat it as a free-roam experiment and expect the response.
trophies.where: VCIA, the airport named in the official description. No terminal or gate is given.
trophies.when: Not pinned: the official text gives no chapter.
sources: Exophase - name, description and grade.
PSNProfiles - not used; one departure is the whole target.
Our advice - mission order, location and method checked against launch-week guides (PowerPyx, PlayStationTrophies, gta.guide).
trophies.advice: VCIA is the Vice-Dale County airport. Steal a passenger jet from a boarding bridge (gates E3 and E4 work), take off, and keep flying about a kilometre before the trophy pops; police respond fast, so save first.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The official description is a joke rather than an instruction: it points at a Rhino, a tank. Our reading is that you need to get your hands on one and put it to use. Where a tank can be taken, and when, is not in the official text, so we will not name a spot for it.
trophies.where: Not pinned: the official text names only the Rhino.
trophies.when: Not pinned: no chapter or mission is given.
sources: Exophase - name, description and grade.
PSNProfiles - not used; no numeric target is stated.
Our advice - mission order, location and method checked against launch-week guides (PowerPyx, PlayStationTrophies, gta.guide).
trophies.advice: Rhino tanks sit at Mile Zero Air Station on Goose Key, south of the Keys. Get in and drive out, and fire the cannon if the trophy lags; the tank carries a military tracker and the base brings a six-star level you cannot shake.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Detection is the whole condition, so scout the staff and the room before you move, and if the alarm goes, restart the attempt cleanly instead of pushing on.
trophies.where: A jewelry store. The official text does not name the store or the district.
trophies.when: Free roam; repeatable until you get a clean run.
sources: Exophase - name, description and grade.
PSNProfiles - not used; the stealth condition is the whole target.
Our advice - mission order, location and method checked against launch-week guides (PowerPyx, PlayStationTrophies, gta.guide).
trophies.advice: Yasmani's Chapter 3 jewelry jobs unlock the Snap Gun, which opens a store's back door quietly; kicking it in sets off the alarm. Find the safe code on a bench in the back room, empty only the safe and leave unseen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in downtown Vice City is the easiest target.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape each time. The official text fixes five and says nothing about which banks, so mark each vault off as you find it and count only the ones you get out of.
trophies.where: Bank vaults. No bank or district is named.
trophies.when: Not pinned: no chapter is given.
sources: Exophase - name, description and grade.
PSNProfiles - not used; five vaults is in the official description.
Our advice - mission order, location and method checked against launch-week guides (PowerPyx, PlayStationTrophies, gta.guide).
trophies.advice: That's Where The Money Is, an optional Chapter 4 mission, teaches vault jobs by trailing an armoured van. Bring your partner for the bags and expect four stars on entry; five of the eight vaults earn this and 100% wants all eight.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The official text names no route, so take one where you see it, then break contact before you count it; a robbery without the escape is not the trophy.
trophies.where: Not pinned: no truck route is given.
trophies.when: Free roam; no chapter is given.
sources: Exophase - name, description and grade.
PSNProfiles - not used; one truck and escape is the whole target.
Our advice - mission order, location and method checked against launch-week guides (PowerPyx, PlayStationTrophies, gta.guide).
trophies.advice: Watch for an armoured truck in traffic and stop it, or pay Yasmani $10,000 for a tip after That's Where The Money Is. Escaping a bank vault job also counts, per GTABase; either way, get clear of the heat zone before you relax.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The official text gives the count; the map's own area list is the checklist, so drive the edges of each district and tick a new area when the game names it.
trophies.where: All of Leonida. No area list is given in the official text.
trophies.when: Free roam; a natural companion to the story driving.
sources: Exophase - name, description and grade.
PSNProfiles - not used; 52 is in the official description.
Our advice - mission order, location and method checked against launch-week guides (PowerPyx, PlayStationTrophies, gta.guide).
trophies.advice: The trophy is the map fog: drive, sail or fly until every region is uncovered. A plane is the quickest way to sweep Leonida, and the pause map shows what is still grey.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang, nine gangs in all. The official text gives the number of crews but no operations or districts, so identify one job per gang and work down the list.
trophies.where: Not pinned: no gang territory or operation is named.
trophies.when: Not pinned: no chapter is given.
sources: Exophase - name, description and grade.
PSNProfiles - not used; nine gangs is in the official description.
Our advice - mission order, location and method checked against launch-week guides (PowerPyx, PlayStationTrophies, gta.guide).
trophies.advice: Nine gangs each need one Illegal Operation robbed, so use the yellow map icons and vary the gang. Examples are the Kingfishers' Sunrise RV Park and the Kolts' old bowling alley in Port Gellhorn; 100% wants all 39 operations.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The official text names the district but not the bar, so find a waterfront spot there and order a drink. Do it early, while you are free to wander.
trophies.where: Ocean Beach, the district named in the official description. The venue is not named.
trophies.when: Not pinned: no chapter or mission is given.
sources: Exophase - name, description and grade.
PSNProfiles - not used; one drink is the whole target.
Our advice - mission order, location and method checked against launch-week guides (PowerPyx, PlayStationTrophies, gta.guide).
trophies.advice: Go to the Ocean View rooftop bar on Ocean Beach, past the pool and up the lift, and buy the $10 Apple Martini. Drink it while standing next to the bar.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The official text does not name the showroom or the vehicle; the point is the exit, so arrive in something heavy and leave through the glass.
trophies.where: A vehicle showroom. Not pinned: no district or showroom is named.
trophies.when: Not pinned: no chapter is given.
sources: Exophase - name, description and grade.
PSNProfiles - not used; one exit is the whole target.
Our advice - mission order, location and method checked against launch-week guides (PowerPyx, PlayStationTrophies, gta.guide).
trophies.advice: Only the blue Banshee in the showroom in south Vice City counts, and it needs the Key Cloner from Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs in Chapter 3. Clone in, drive straight through the showroom window and keep going: the trophy is delayed.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. The official text names the alley; it does not name a frame or a score, so bowl a full game there and finish it.
trophies.where: Kolt & Associates' bowling alley, named in the official description. No address is given.
trophies.when: Not pinned: no chapter is given. Bowl early.
sources: Exophase - name, description and grade.
PSNProfiles - not used; one game is the whole target.
Our advice - mission order, location and method checked against launch-week guides (PowerPyx, PlayStationTrophies, gta.guide).
trophies.advice: Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn is the Kolts' operation from Chapter 2. Bring Sticky Bombs, take the luxury watch, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun and the office safe contents, then lose the police. Miss something and the operation returns later.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The official description gives nothing away: a partnership moment with mass appeal. Our reading is a public, crowd-facing activity done with your partner. The official text pins no activity, place or chapter, so we will not invent one.
trophies.where: Not pinned: no place is named.
trophies.when: Not pinned: no chapter is named.
sources: Exophase - name, description and grade.
PSNProfiles - not used; no numeric target is stated.
Our advice - mission order, location and method checked against launch-week guides (PowerPyx, PlayStationTrophies, gta.guide).
trophies.advice: Max Strength for Jason and Lucia, and working out together at a gym trains both at once. Strength also helps in melee, so this is worth finishing before the 100% sweep.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. The official description is deliberately vague and PSN tracks a count towards 500, so this is a long-tail counter rather than one moment: take choices as they come in story and side jobs, and let the counter do the remembering.
trophies.where: Wherever the game offers a choice. No location is named.
trophies.when: Across the whole run; the count is long.
sources: Exophase - name, description and grade.
PSNProfiles - PSN progress target: a count towards 500 choices.
Our advice - mission order, location and method checked against launch-week guides (PowerPyx, PlayStationTrophies, gta.guide).
trophies.advice: 500 actions that change the Criminal Profile earn this, and robberies, fights and story choices all count. Choices such as the Lab Fees clerk or sparing Arnold in Hey Arnold! feed it, so play rather than grind, and do not push the profile to Irredeemable.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The official description hints at a retry: fail once and succeed on the next attempt. Our reading is a deliberate first failure followed by a clean second run of the same challenge. The official text does not name the challenge.
trophies.where: Not pinned: no challenge or place is named.
trophies.when: Any time you can retry a challenge.
sources: Exophase - name, description and grade.
PSNProfiles - not used; no numeric target is stated.
Our advice - mission order, location and method checked against launch-week guides (PowerPyx, PlayStationTrophies, gta.guide).
trophies.advice: The trigger is still unconfirmed. PowerPyx's best guess is failing and retrying the Prologue payday loan robbery, so save first and retry a botched robbery; experiment on a throwaway save.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: A deliberately cryptic description. Our reading is that you have to witness something strange in the world: a scripted oddity, not a mission. The official text names neither the event nor its location, so explore and let it find you.
trophies.where: Not pinned: no place is named.
trophies.when: Not pinned: no chapter is named.
sources: Exophase - name, description and grade.
PSNProfiles - not used; no numeric target is stated.
Our advice - mission order, location and method checked against launch-week guides (PowerPyx, PlayStationTrophies, gta.guide).
trophies.advice: Most guides point to a UFO abduction near the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2 AM. A second lead is the glowing graffiti code in Crosstown, east of the Pawn & Gun, which opens a ground-floor safe.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by: swing a melee weapon from a moving vehicle. Do it in traffic and be ready to lose the response afterwards; a normal drive-by with a gun is not the same thing.
trophies.where: Any road with traffic. No location is named.
trophies.when: Free roam; retryable.
sources: Exophase - name, description and grade.
PSNProfiles - not used; one hit is the whole target.
Our advice - mission order, location and method checked against launch-week guides (PowerPyx, PlayStationTrophies, gta.guide).
trophies.advice: A melee drive-by means kicking from a bike: press Square while riding past pedestrians. PowerPyx's single-source method is 10 kicks within 60 seconds, and Ocean Beach's crowded streets are the place to try it.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. The official text gives the amount and the channel, so run the bills through contacts in batches rather than holding them; the counter here tracks progress in dollars.
trophies.where: Through your contacts, as the official text says. No contact or place is named.
trophies.when: As the laundering system opens up.
sources: Exophase - name, description and grade.
PSNProfiles - not used; $250,000 is in the official description.
Our advice - mission order, location and method checked against launch-week guides (PowerPyx, PlayStationTrophies, gta.guide).
trophies.advice: Marked Bills come from bank and payday loan jobs and are laundered by selling them to your contacts, with Yasmani in Little Cuba paying the most. The $250,000 is cumulative, and 100% asks for the same amount.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across the shops. The official text says shops, so read it literally and buy from shop stock rather than counting property or mission costs; spread the spending and let the dollar counter fill.
trophies.where: Shops across Leonida. No shop list is given.
trophies.when: Free roam, once you have the money.
sources: Exophase - name, description and grade.
PSNProfiles - not used; $100,000 is in the official description.
Our advice - mission order, location and method checked against launch-week guides (PowerPyx, PlayStationTrophies, gta.guide).
trophies.advice: Everything bought in a shop counts: guns, car mods, clothes and haircuts. The $100,000 is cumulative, and guns and vehicle mods cost the most, so upgrade instead of saving.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy every garage property. The official description says all of them but gives no number; our tracker uses eight slots, so treat eight as the working count and confirm each purchase against the property list in game.
trophies.where: Garage properties. No location list is given in the official text.
trophies.when: As you earn money through the story and side work.
sources: Exophase - name, description and grade.
PSNProfiles - not used for a number; the working count of eight is our tracker note, not from the description.
Our advice - mission order, location and method checked against launch-week guides (PowerPyx, PlayStationTrophies, gta.guide).
trophies.advice: Eight garages are for sale in the Vice City Real Estate app, about $160,000 for the set, and the app opens after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. The garages the story gives you do not count.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The official text fixes ten and names the app, so do it as you acquire vehicles and register each one before you sell or lose it.
trophies.where: In the Scooter Bros app; no physical location is needed.
trophies.when: Free roam, as you collect vehicles.
sources: Exophase - name, description and grade.
PSNProfiles - not used; ten is in the official description.
Our advice - mission order, location and method checked against launch-week guides (PowerPyx, PlayStationTrophies, gta.guide).
trophies.advice: Moses gives Lucia the Scooter Bros app in the Chapter 2 mission Moses, and registering needs a free garage space. Register 10 cheap cars; from Chapter 3 a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray also works.
